attributes.name: Rust
attributes.description: Rust dedicated server (SteamCMD auto-installed on create). First boot generates world - can take a while. Needs ~6GB RAM minimum.

installation.script:
apt-get update -qq && apt-get install -y -qq curl ca-certificates lib32gcc-s1 xz-utils > /dev/null
curl -sSL -o steamcmd.tar.gz https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/client/installer/steamcmd_linux.tar.gz
tar xzf steamcmd.tar.gz
rm -f steamcmd.tar.gz
./steamcmd.sh +force_install_dir /data +login anonymous +app_update 258550 validate +quit
chmod +x /data/RustDedicated
